import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,hashlib
p=Path.cwd(); b=(p/'inputs/williams.pdf').read_bytes();print(len(b),hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'inputs/williams.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'williams.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,check=True)
print(r.stdout)
